notes.title: Long-Awaited Update
notes.content:
This update has been a long time coming. While trying to create new characters in a fresh way, I encountered significant challenges, and I'm still working on finding solutions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/ca02845e089746c906cc539ee1ac9cdc16cbcdbf.png"]This time, we're introducing a new zombie leader that will randomly appear at the end of levels, dropping exclusive trait armor. Yes, brave warriors, you can now obtain trait equipment earlier to help tackle the two powerful bosses from the last update.
But don’t underestimate this zombie leader—it might become a nightmare on your path to victory.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/e45444c5edce475a191525bd8db4b53b20c30567.png"]On the crafting merchant page, you can now craft resistance chips, which will make it easier to defeat these bosses.I’m working hard on developing new optional characters and weapons, and I hope you’ll be satisfied with my efforts when the next update arrives.

In addition, this update addresses pathfinding issues in the map and fixes potential risks caused by errors in the code. I sincerely apologize for only discovering these issues now. This is my first game developed independently, and I believe I’m continuously improving. After completing all the content for this game, I will start the official development of my next game. I hope these issues won’t occur again. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Regular Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/771facbfa88dab00fb5b0c7af0655f0c91038449.png"]Bug Fixes

1、Some players contacted me, reporting task-related BUGs. After a thorough review, I discovered it was due to a configuration error during development. I sincerely apologize to everyone and thank players for their understanding. If you find any issues, please leave me a message, and I will do my best to fix BUGs as quickly as possible.

2、For players experiencing issues with the task “Jim's Request,” please abandon the task and re-accept it to proceed normally.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/6fc7cbb8ba6b11ce86795b0f83f50ba6e3f24338.png"]New Content

1、The Mechanical Guards summoned by skills were not very useful in previous versions, so this time I enhanced their functionality. These guards now have a range; as long as you are within this range and your health takes damage, the Mechanical Guards will take the damage in place of the controlled character.
2、Added a group of leaping zombies to the zombie horde. Dodging one is easy, but frequent leaps from multiple zombies increase the difficulty, avoiding the issue of repetitive horde patterns. I’ll continue to explore more valuable ways to enhance them in the future.
3、Adjusted the attack speed bonus from upgrades, allowing in-level upgrades to reduce the character’s cooldown time progressively, helping players handle the increasing number of zombies. The Mechanical Guards’ health has also changed from a fixed value to being tied to the player’s character health, scaling with in-level upgrades.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/34a4be4db56ffd58375affb06bd85c9f1223b259.png"]Update Philosophy

Passionate players have given me suggestions, hoping I can learn from gameplay in better works. We had deep discussions on many topics, which I find incredibly valuable as a solo developer. To add these creative ideas to the map in the future, I need to create more synergy between skill combinations, making random choices more fun.
The enhancement of Mechanical Guards was considered from two aspects: future equipment design and map gameplay design.
Equipment Design: The goal is to allow players to engage in cautious combat, avoiding the need to constantly dodge. By having guards absorb damage, the trigger speed of equipped chips is significantly increased, enabling future development of damage-triggered chips and equipment.
Level Design: For map gameplay, I’ve considered mechanics similar to POE2’s altar system. To create such high-pressure, high-intensity experiences, close-quarters combat is necessary.

notes.title: Weapon Update
notes.content:
1、The skill effect of the rifle "M4N2" has been adjusted to make it more powerful and rewarding to use.  

2、A new pistol, "P5," has been added, ensuring that even cute girl characters remain strong with pistols. 

3、Two new shotguns, "N1" and "N2," have been introduced. These shotguns have different pellet spread patterns, and their attached skills are completely distinct, offering more options for skill combinations.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/01d262c1dd2a71e29dd32df20dba4aabcc0298c2.png"]

I’m continuously refining weapon combinations and balance. In the next update, I plan to introduce unique zombies to bring more challenges to players in levels.

notes.title: Big Update Arrives as Promised
notes.content:
About Your Feedback
[olist]
I’m just a solo indie game dev, so I’m thrilled to hear all your feedback. Back in the demo phase, some players asked for controller support, and I promised I’d do my best to add it. After a week of hard work, it’s finally here! You can check out the new controller guide in the settings menu while playing.

Item pickup filtering was another suggestion from a player, and I thought it was a great idea, so I added it.

I’ve also tried implementing AMD and NVIDIA super-resolution and frame-boosting features. Some players reported crashes with NVIDIA cards, so I’ve added a GPU toggle. Since the game isn’t some massive, epic open-world adventure, I didn’t dive too deep into optimizing this. If you feel the same way I do, you can turn off the GPU toggle and still play smoothly with Unreal Engine 5’s default display mode.

Some players in the test version mentioned that dragging and selling items would fail. I found the bug and fixed it in this update.

A few players suggested having items drop on the ground when opening chests. Honestly, I think it’s better to have them go straight into the inventory if there’s space—saves you from waiting a second in the middle of a zombie horde! But if more of you want ground drops, I’m open to making some changes.
[/olist]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/85b1ad462aef1fd068f53f86ccfbe45ae187b16a.png"]

About My Promises
[olist]
I’ve pretty much delivered on the features I promised for the demo. If anything feels clunky or needs tweaking, just let me know. It’s a chance for me to tackle new tech and make the game smoother for everyone.

Going forward, I’ll aim for updates every one to two weeks, adding little things to the levels that I think are fun. I hope you’ll enjoy fresh challenges and content regularly.

I mentioned in the demo that I’d laid the groundwork for multiplayer. To be honest, I underestimated how tricky it’d be. It’s going to take some serious code reevaluation and tweaking, so it might take a bit longer than expected.

As for new characters, there are two more coming. I promised they won’t be DLC—they’ll be free updates, and I’m working hard to make them feel fresh and unique.

Lastly, about monsters and boss designs, some players recently shared awesome ideas. I’m excited to work on bringing those into the game.
[/olist]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/aeae2f1b33c98ccf5695fc36bc386d568b73b786.png"]

A huge thanks to all the players supporting me. This is my first solo indie game, and I’m committed to keep going and making more fun games. I hope you’ll stick with me and continue supporting my journey!

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
I’m sorry, guys. I’ve updated again in a hurry. I’m gradually debugging the gamepad function. During the game, after disabling auto - casting, I found it very hard to cast skills by pressing the number keys in the middle of a horde of zombies. It’s also not easy to cast skills after changing the keys. So I took it upon myself to make use of the left and right mouse buttons for casting. I hope you’ll like this change.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/88fde997461638de421d00724c2f84f914a7bd19.png"]

The left mouse button and the right mouse button can cast one selected skill each.

The mouse wheel can change the setting of the left mouse button.

Alt + mouse wheel can change the setting of the right mouse button.

notes.title: Update Content
notes.content:
Update Content



1、To allow new players to experience the melee skill attack effects more quickly, I have made the situation where no weapon is equipped in the off-hand the same as the situation where the off-hand is equipped with the same weapon as the main hand. In both cases, players can enjoy the mechanism of melee weapons being able to cast two skills, as well as the mechanism of ranged weapons that reload ammunition to activate the embedded chip skills.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/8c89847a5e195e2b05bddba7f1b3ae7b5e365e4b.png"]2、Modified the mechanics of skills that revolve around oneself, laying the groundwork for future characters with teleportation abilities.

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/467a4a515761cac6e8ac1f85e702db53c55d437f.png"]

Innovation Content



1. Some skills have had their casting animations removed.

2. More zombies have been added to the game, with their distribution made more even to prevent them from all following the player.

3. Characters will now start with two weapons by default to avoid the limitation of having only one weapon and to enhance the gaming experience.

4. Vincent will start with a rifle, with the knife in his backpack. Mike will also receive a basic shotgun.

5. In combat scenarios, leveling up will increase the in-game slashing speed, shooting speed, and attack range.

6. All skills that deal damage with projectile ammunition will now have a penetration effect that increases with level.

7. Secondary weapons, which previously had no attribute bonuses, have now been given practical functions.

• 7.1 If both hands are holding knives, skills that release sword energy or slash will perform two attacks. Other skills that do not require specific weapons will have a chance to fire in bursts.

• 7.2 When reloading firearms, the additional skill embedded in the equipped chip will be immediately triggered.

• 7.3 For example, if Vincent equips the Thunderstorm Chip and purchases a pistol with an attached skill from the store, the skill of the Thunderstorm Chip will be triggered immediately after every 5 shots. This allows for better synergy between the equipped chips and the chosen weapons.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/8c89847a5e195e2b05bddba7f1b3ae7b5e365e4b.png"]

Bug Fixes



1. Fixed the issue with incorrect storage of settings.

2. Corrected some text description errors.

3. Optimized the logic for randomly upgrading skills to prevent the inability to get more random results without spending currency.

notes.title: Feature Update
notes.content:
In this update, equipment modification has been upgraded. Each modified piece of equipment can now not only be enhanced with stat-boosting chips but can also be embedded with skill-infused chips. These chips enable the equipment to automatically trigger various skills in a loop during battle, without any cost.

New Chips:

1、Minor Health Regeneration – Gradually restores a small amount of health to the character.
2、Minor Energy Regeneration – Gradually restores a small amount of psychic energy.
3、Fireball Launch – Fires three flaming fireballs in different directions. The fireballs orbit and attack zombies in a set pattern.
4、Electric Blade – Throws a ninja blade charged with electricity that pierces through all zombies along its path.
5、Lightning Strike – Calls down a bolt of lightning at a random location near the character.
6、Thunderstorm – Summons three bolts of lightning at random locations near the character.
7、Shocking Zone – Creates an electric zone on the ground. Enemies walking through it will have their movement speed reduced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/a0a4a778bdd4043934e4a68725c215ae381acaa0.png

Rage Energy:

This is a new mechanic added specifically for the new chips. The character slowly gains Rage Energy over time. Rage is also generated when the character takes damage, lands a critical hit, or triggers a chip-based skill. Once the energy bar is full, the cooldown time of chip-triggered skills is significantly reduced. The character will then unleash these skills rapidly, mowing down hordes of zombies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/f6e94c85e8b9023cfce1398ec196c927a726f6ef.png

notes.title: Update Content:
notes.content:
Update Content:

1. Critical hits will cause monsters to stagger, making critical hit rate more effective in combat.
2. The progress of game levels will affect the difficulty of combat within the map.
3. The "Buff" that increases movement speed has been modified to add 150 points of movement speed for 25 seconds.
4. Adjusted the stamina consumption for sprinting, increasing the efficiency of sprinting.
5. The range for equipment pickup has been expanded.
6. Dark Sphere enhancement now increases the number of level 2 and 3 spheres.
7. In the map, there is now a chance to encounter new zombies that can jump and dodge attacks in mid-air. Be cautious when encountering them.
8. Zombies with elemental attacks have appeared in the map. Their different elemental effects can be clearly distinguished by the auras surrounding them.
9. The character "Michael" now uses a roll instead of sprinting. During the roll, he will be immune to damage, and some ongoing attacks may be interrupted based on the timing of the roll.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/5e8c731a41023638d172ecf20a2983319768258f.png

notes.title: The first step of the major update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/f586f290315185122970549f4e1aa0570a2768cc.png
New Features:

1. Added new equipment items for: upgrading and modifying equipment. These items allow equipment to be upgraded and modified.
2. Equipment Upgrade: This feature enhances the attributes of equipment and reduces the difficulty of challenge maps, thereby increasing the efficiency of character progression.
3. Equipment Modification: This allows equipment to be fitted with chips, which is another way to boost attributes.
4. Equipment Chips: By obtaining materials through combat and interacting with specific NPCs, players can craft chips that can enhance weapons.
5. Mysterious Merchant: Players can spend currency to purchase equipment with random attributes from the merchant. Grinding more money can also help characters become stronger more quickly.
6. Drop Rate Adjustment: The higher the map difficulty, the fewer recovery items zombies will drop.
7. Attack Animations: Some skills have had their attack animations removed to make skill casting smoother.
8. Boss Health Bar: A health bar has been added for minor bosses to make powerful targets more visible during combat.
9. Followers: A new talent branch for followers has been introduced. By increasing this talent, players can summon their own saved followers into combat scenes.
10. New Talent: The new follower talent allows followers to accompany the main character, gain random skills in combat, and enhance the attack power of summoned followers.

For specific gameplay and instructions, feel free to join my “Discord” to check out my update notes.

Bug Fixes and Updates:

1. Character Pickup Bug The bug related to character pickups has been fixed. Experience and similar gains will no longer be placed into the inventory.
2. Item Image Updates The item images have been updated. When opening the inventory, items under the mouse cursor will now display a checkbox.
3. Store Weapon Effect Issue The issue where special-effect weapons from the store would revert to normal weapons after being discarded on the ground has been resolved.

Follow-up Content:

1. Critical Hit Stun: Adds more significance to critical hits. Zombies have a chance to become stunned after being hit by a critical strike.
2. Multi-Attribute Zombies: Introduces more zombies with different damage types, making resistances more meaningful.
3. Enhanced Zombies: Adds zombies with abilities such as displacement and jumping to the map.
4. Equipment Enhancement: Introduces more enhancement chips. Players can insert these chips into their equipment to gain additional skills.
5. Movement Mechanics: Adjusts the movement capabilities of different characters. In addition to increased speed, new functions such as rolling and blinking will be added.

Future Outlook:

1. The game has pre-embedded online functionality, but it has not been activated yet due to issues with completeness. Once the game version is gradually completed, online functionality for friends will be activated at the right time.
2. Gamepad support was suggested by enthusiastic players, and this will be gradually added in the future. Adding gamepad support will make the game more convenient to play.
3. After the skill system is perfected, more visually appealing characters will be added to the game. These characters will not be added as "DLC"; they will be available as updates to those who have purchased the base game.
4. The missing Steam achievements will also be gradually added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460289/1c0231d9c249358d8cf7a94687542d29931a1ebf.png

In this month and a bit, I have learned more techniques and development skills. Shortly after the official release, I hope this character can be introduced as the fifth character, meeting everyone as scheduled.

notes.title: This is a great achievement
notes.content:
The development team is not proficient in all the languages of the world. However, in order to better serve more players and share our creations with everyone, we have still made an effort to translate into more languages, including:
• Simplified Chinese
• Traditional Chinese
• Russian
• French
• German
• Turkish
• Polish
• Japanese
• Korean
• Spanish
• Portuguese (Brazil)
This is our effort. If you are following our game, or even added it to your wishlist, I believe your support is well placed, and we will continue to work hard.
This is my first time posting an announcement. I will keep you updated on the development progress in the future. Friends who support me, please leave a message and join the discussion.
